text: As I enter this space, the sleek lines of glass, steel, and light create a sense of calm anticipation. I feel as though I am on the edge of discovery, standing at the threshold of knowledge. The large R+D sign on the vibrant wall invites inquiry, promising innovation and new ways of seeing and engaging with the world. Here, surrounded by the tools of learning and creation, I feel both small and empowered, aware of the potential for revelation within these walls.
